reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to how you manage resources in Provincia! No longer will build tiles hide a multi-resource bill behind a single cost chip. Each entry now displays a comprehensive Materials sheet, allowing you to see stored versus required resources at a glance, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change will help you plan your builds more effectively. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
